key_insight: Scaling humanoid Behavior Foundation Models works best when motion tracking, diverse on-policy data, and a scalable transformer architecture are coordinated together.
engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical recipe for building more general, higher-fidelity humanoid controllers that transfer better across tasks and environments.
method: Reformulate humanoid control as global-frame motion tracking of integrated whole-body behaviors.
Balance on-policy rollout volume with diverse reference motion data for better scaling.
Use the Humanoid Transformer to learn structured behavioral representations at scale.
evidence_signal: Across simulation and real-world deployment, the method reduced test MPKPE by over 10% in local mode and 82% in global mode versus existing humanoid controllers.
watch_item: Performance gains may depend on careful tuning of data diversity, rollout quantity, and architecture, so the recipe may not transfer unchanged to all humanoid platforms or motion datasets.
paper_title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
